title: The 5 Best-Selling Video Games Ever, Ranked (#1 Isn't Even Close)

scenes.text: The five best-selling video games ever. Number one isn't even close.

scenes.label: Mario Kart 8 · 79 million
scenes.text: Number five: Mario Kart 8, first released in 2014. About 79 million copies sold.

scenes.label: Wii Sports · 83 million
scenes.text: Number four: Wii Sports, from 2006. About 83 million copies. It held third place for years.

scenes.label: Red Dead 2 · 85 million
scenes.text: Number three: Red Dead Redemption 2. It passed 85 million in 2026 and took that spot.

scenes.label: GTA V · ~230 million
scenes.text: Number two: Grand Theft Auto Five. Close to 230 million copies since 2013.

scenes.label: Minecraft · 350 million
scenes.text: Number one: Minecraft. 350 million copies, about 120 million ahead of second place. A game made of blocks beat them all.

description:
The five best-selling video games of all time, ranked by copies sold.
Minecraft passed 350 million copies in 2025. Grand Theft Auto V is close to 230 million. Red Dead Redemption 2 crossed 85 million in 2026, according to its publisher's results, and overtook Wii Sports (about 83 million) for third place. Mario Kart 8 follows with about 79 million.
Which of the five did you play the most?
first_comment: Minecraft went from 238 million in 2021 to 350 million in 2025. Which game would you put at number one, and what should we rank next?
